A '''Mysess blossom''' was a rare type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], normally in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]]. They had [[Color/Legends|yellow]], red, and pink petals, and a green stem.

Chief [[Kerritamba]] used a Mysess blossom in an elixir he used to cure the illness of the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Great Tree]].

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mysess blossoms appeared in the video game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
